title: Viva Las Scottsdale by Scottsdale Beach Club
description: Welcome to Viva Las Scottsdale – our newest luxury getaway – featuring your own private Casino & outdoor Vegas-style Beach Club. Each of the 6 bedrooms (sleeps 16) is modeled after an iconic Las Vegas hotel so the photo opportunities are endless and the experience is uniquely memorable. The “beach club” backyard features a sparkling pool, outdoor games, endless lounging space, and a mini golf course. What happens in Scottsdale stays in Scottsdale!
amenities: Clothing storage: walk-in closet, closet, and dresser
Paid high chair - available upon request
Paid pack ’n play/travel crib - available upon request
Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours, heated, pool toys
review_snippets: This home is a guest favorite based on ratings, reviews, and reliability

The house was great and spacious perfect for our group, the house had a lot of amenities and cute decorations that made for a lot of good photo ops! Would recommend this house to anyone looking to book it!
This was a cute house with a neat theme. The host was responsive and gave us some recommendations for dinner.

This house was absolutely incredible. The hosts were so informative and extremely responsive! Incredibly affordable for a large group considering all of the included amenities and distance to Old Town! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!!!
Awesome home for our friends bachelor weekend. Really spacious, clean and comfortable. Host was very responsive. Backyard is amazing and has everything you need. Would definitely come back!
